text:
maria.g: quick check — can we enable temporary full request-body capture for /v1/generate in staging to debug a user failure? I think the failing payload includes a credit-card number and an email. proposing 24h retention, KMS-encrypted S3, and deterministic HMAC for PII fields. who can approve?

sam.k: i'd prefer not to store raw cc numbers. can we hash cc/email/phone with HMAC-SHA256 using a rotation key? store only hashed values + safe metadata. :+1:

alex.r: also watch out for prompt tokens — some users send bearer tokens inside prompt metadata. need to strip Authorization header and any field named `auth` or `token` before storage.

security-bot: policy reminder: production bodies with PII require a jira + manager + sec approval. staging is allowed for short windows if obfuscated and access logged. post the jira id here.

jess.l: i can sign off for staging 24h if you: 1) remove Authorization header server-side, 2) HMAC emails/phones/cc with app secret, 3) limit S3 ACLs and enable access logging. also add lifecycle to delete after 24h.

maria.g: thanks jess. i'll open the ticket. quick snippet for the HMAC i'll use: ```python
import hmac, hashlib
KEY = b"<rotating-secret>"
def hmac_hex(value):
    return hmac.new(KEY, value.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
```

sam.k: that looks fine. ensure the KEY is from KMS and not checked into code. also redact any utterance that matches CC regex before hashing just in case.

devops-tim: if approved, i'll create bucket `s3://redwood-debug/maria-1871234567/` with server-side encryption and restricted IAM. retention=1 day. who needs access?

maria.g: access list: me, sam.k, alex.r, jess.l, devops-tim. i'll attach the ticket link once created. plan: capture bodies for 24h, run local scrub + hmac, upload to S3, delete after 24h.

security-bot: noted. remember to remove any logs that include the full prompt after debug window. post the jira and approval here before enabling. :eyes:

jess.l: approved conditional on jira + config posted in the ticket.

maria.g: opening ticket now, will link it here in ~5m. thanks all :thumbsup:
